newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan gasoline price unchanged month/month--survey.
newsitem.headline: Japan gasoline price unchanged month/month--survey.

text.p: The average retail price of gasoline at petrol stations throughout Japan was 105 yen per litre as of October 10, unchanged from a month earlier, a research centre said on Wednesday.
A survey by the Oil Information Service Centre showed that the retail price of kerosene, used for heating, as of October 10 had risen by three yen per 18 litres from a month earlier to 858 yen.
The national average retail price of gas oil, mainly used by trucks and buses for fuel, was 81 yen per litre. The retail price of gas oil has not changed since April.
Taxes account for 53.8 yen of the retail price of gasoline and 32.1 yen of the gas oil price. Kerosene, categorised as a household necessity, is not taxed.
Refiners have been raising their oil product wholesale prices recently, reflecting soaring global crude prices and the yen's weakness against the dollar.
However, the retail price has not been following the rise in wholesale prices because of competition among gasoline stations and opposition from consumers.
